knowledge_gaps: The matched-mask control isolates context removal, but both arms discard supervision relative to the corrected baseline. Include an unmodified baseline to establish whether cropping improves the original training procedure.

Padding-safe recurrence is assumed rather than specified. Zero embeddings can still change GRU hidden states through biases. Define hidden-state initialization, padding handling, aligned output reconstruction, and empty-history behavior consistently in training and the embedded predictor.

A dedicated crop generator alone does not guarantee matched experiments. Specify reproducible batch, negative-sampling, crop-plan, and dropout streams; define the exact loss mask, loss normalization, checkpoint rule, and handling of short histories.

Uniform cropping by event count does not directly test age-based staleness. Its effects depend on history truncation and interaction frequency, and full-history inference introduces a training–inference context mismatch.

The report lacks a budget allocation and a precise validation selection protocol. Compare complete four-category configurations using macro HR@10, quantify paired uncertainty where host outputs permit, and avoid interpreting a single-seed result as seed robustness.

Originality 5/10 and difficulty 3/10 are insufficiently justified without closer augmentation comparisons and verification of the supplied GRU implementation. Potential 7/10 remains speculative; no measured context-removal or validation improvement is available.
